'''Gable''' is [[Warder]] to [[Nadira]].
== History ==
Gable accompanies Nadira to the village of [[Aturo's Orchard]] on the border between [[Almoth Plain]] and [[Toman Head]] after she grows worried when [[Megda]] and [[Maynard]] do not return from the region when investigating claims of women who can use the [[One Power]] to harm others.

Gable later accompanied Nadira to [[Tanchico]] when she went to investigate the activities of [[Belyne]] Sedai.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
